summary: Iteration-6 targeted test of two new employer features: (1) Applicant CSV export via GET /api/v1/employer/jobs/:id/applicants/export and (2) Resume inline preview via GET /api/v1/employer/resumes/:id/download?inline=1. Added 6 new backend pytest cases (TestApplicantsCsvExport x3, TestResumeInlinePreview x3) — all 6 PASS. Frontend: logged in as hr@acmetech.in, opened QA Automation Engineer pipeline, exercised export-applicants (200 text/csv, attachment, correct filename 'QA-Automation-Engineer-applicants.csv'), applicant-resume-preview-<id> (200 application/pdf, Content-Disposition: inline), applicant-resume-<id> (200 pdf, attachment). Verified historical candidate report path via /employer/verify → Open report → report-preview-resume (200 inline pdf) and report-download-resume (200 attachment pdf). Everything works end-to-end. The 5 other backend failures in the full suite are pre-existing and unrelated: 4 are due to Acme's 0-credit balance (already flagged in iteration_5 context) and 1 is a score-drift assertion in TestAdminDataExplorer (expected 940 got 945, pre-existing drift).
action_items: Optional: reseed Acme credits (/api/v1/billing/credits/purchase or node src/seeds/seed.js --reset) so TestEmployerLookup / TestReportContact pass in the full suite. Not required for the two new features.
critical_code_review_comments: employerController.exportApplicants: filename sanitiser strips most non-word chars; good. Minor: no explicit cap on applicants count — a job with 100k applicants would stream a huge CSV in-memory. Acceptable for current scale but consider pagination/streaming (res.write chunks) if usage grows.

exportApplicants uses jobService.applicants(req.employer, req.params.id) which already enforces employer-scope — cross-employer returns 403/404 (verified). Audit log 'applicants.exported' is recorded with count meta — verified via /employer/audit-trail.
downloadResume inline branch gates inline strictly on resume.mimeType === 'application/pdf' (correct — DOC/DOCX stay as attachment). Good defensive behaviour.

previewResume client (employerService.js) uses URL.createObjectURL + window.open; some popup blockers may block if the click handler goes through an async await before window.open. Currently it awaits fetch then calls window.open — browsers may treat this as programmatic and block the popup. Works in Playwright/Chromium (verified) but worth a UX note.
exportApplicants CSV is prefixed with UTF-8 BOM (﻿) — good for Excel. Row separator is '\n' only; Excel on Windows is fine with that, but consider '\r\n' for maximum compatibility.

success_rate.backend: 100% on new feature tests (6/6). Full suite: 77/82 non-skipped pass; 5 failures all pre-existing (credit balance + score drift).
success_rate.frontend: 100% — export, preview, download, report-preview, report-download all verified via network response capture.
